sn22.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare papāte pabbate.
sn22.3:1.3: atha kho hāliddikāni gahapati yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho hāliddikāni gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca
sn22.3:1.4: vuttamidaṃ bhante, bhagavatā aṭṭhakavaggiye māgandiya pañhe –
sn22.3:3.1: imassa nu kho bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti?
sn22.3:5.2: rūpadhātuyā kho gahapati, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn22.3:5.6: saṅkhāradhātuyā kho gahapati, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. tasmā tathāgato anokasārīti vuccati.
sn22.3:5.7: viññāṇadhātuyā kho gahapati, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn22.3:7.2: rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho gahapati, tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn22.3:7.8: dhammanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho gahapati, tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn22.3:8.2: idha gahapati, ekacco gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī sukhitesu sukhito dukkhitesu dukkhito. uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā voyogaṃ āpajjati.
sn22.3:8.3: evaṃ kho gahapati, gāme santhavajāto hoti.
sn22.3:9.1: kathañca gahapati, gāme na santhavajāto hoti:
sn22.3:9.2: idha gahapati, ekacco gihīhi asaṃsaṭṭho viharati na sahanandī na sahasokī na sukhitesu sukhito na dukkhitesu dukkhito. uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu na attanā voyogaṃ, āpajjati.
sn22.3:9.3: evaṃ kho gahapati, gāme na santhavajāto hoti.
sn22.3:10.2: idha gahapati, ekacco kāmesu avigatarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
sn22.3:10.3: evaṃ kho gahapati, kāmehi aritto hoti.
sn22.3:11.2: idha gahapati, ekacco kāmesu vigatarāgo hoti vigatachando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho.
sn22.3:11.3: evaṃ kho gahapati, kāmehi ritto hoti.
sn22.3:12.3: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti.
sn22.3:13.2: idha gahapati, ekaccassa na evaṃ hoti:
sn22.3:13.3: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsaññī siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ.
sn22.3:14.1: kathañca gahapati, kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti:
sn22.3:14.2: idha gahapati, ekacco evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti:
sn22.3:14.3: na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi. ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi. kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi? micchāpaṭipanno tvamasi ahamasmi sammāpaṭipanno. pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca. sahitaṃ me asahitaṃ te. āciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo. cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahitosi. nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī”ti.
sn22.3:14.4: evaṃ kho gahapati, kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti.
sn22.3:15.1: kathañca gahapati, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti:
sn22.3:15.2: idha gahapati, ekacco na evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti:
sn22.3:15.3: “na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi. kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi? micchā paṭipanno tvamasi ahamasmi sammā paṭipanno. pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca, sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te, acinnaṃ te viparāvattaṃ āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya niggahitosi nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī”ti.
sn22.3:15.4: evaṃ kho gahapati, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti.
sn22.3:16.1: iti gahapati, yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā aṭṭhakavaggiye māgandiyapañhe
sn22.3:18.1: imassa kho gahapati, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
